department: Department of Molecular, Cellular & Developmental Biology

deadline.value: Final deadline for domestic and international applicants is November 20; fall entry only (year inferred for Fall 2027).
deadline.quote: November 20th – Final deadline for both domestic and international students.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required and is not considered even if submitted.
gre_general.quote: Note: GRE is not required and will not be considered in the admissions decision if the student chooses to provide it.

supervisor.value: First-year students rotate through four labs and choose a thesis advisor by the end of the first year.
supervisor.quote: Students rotate through four laboratories of their choice to become familiar with the research programs

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with a 2.75 GPA is the minimum; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college with a minimum cumulative grade point average of 2.75 (on a 4-point scale).
